Description
These rounds depict the Pan American Silver Corporation, a highly-respected name in precious metals and is among the largest primary silver producers in the world.
It was issued by the Northwest Territorial Mint, and its purity is co-certified by the Pan American Silver Corp.
Design of 1 oz Pan American Silver Corp Rounds
This investment silver is known as a “round” because it has no denomination. It is issued by a private institution.
The obverse shows the well known silver hammer logo of Pan American Silver.
The reverse shows a miner drilling for silver ore.
